title.ja: 図1-1 角交換している局面
title.en: Figure 1-1: Position after a bishop exchange

explain.ja: まずはオーソドックスな棒銀風の攻めから紹介します。図1-1では角交換しているのがポイントです。
explain.en: First, an orthodox Climbing Silver-style attack. The key in Diagram 1-1 is that the bishops have been exchanged.

section.ja: ▲5六角とする攻め
section.en: Attack with ▲5六角

title.ja: 図1-2 露骨な角打ちだが受けがない
title.en: Figure 1-2: An obvious bishop drop, but there is no defense

explain.ja: 銀と飛車だけでは攻め駒が足りないので、いきなり▲5六角と打ちます。これは8三に利きを足しています。狙いは露骨ですが、相手は受けるのが難しい手です。
explain.en: Silver and rook alone are not enough attackers, so drop the bishop at once with ▲5六角. It adds control to 8三. The aim is obvious, yet the opponent finds it hard to defend.

section.ja: ▲5六角とする攻め
section.en: Attack with ▲5六角

title.ja: 図1-3 狙いの棒銀
title.en: Figure 1-3: The targeted Climbing Silver

explain.ja: 5六角打ちの狙いは、図1-3のように▲8四歩、△同歩、▲同銀と攻めることです。後手はそれがわかっていても受けられません。
explain.en: The aim of the ▲5六角 drop is to attack with ▲8四歩, △同歩, ▲同銀 as in Diagram 1-3. White cannot defend even knowing this.

section.ja: ▲5六角とする攻め
section.en: Attack with ▲5六角

title.ja: 図1-4 こんなところに角を打ちたくない
title.en: Figure 1-4: I do not want to drop the bishop here

explain.ja: 唯一の受けは図1-2から△9二角と打つくらいですが(図1-4)、今度は▲9五歩と端攻めで角をいじめれば十分です。▲5六角と打てるだけで優勢になるので、相振り飛車では常に狙いたい角打ちです。この5六への筋違いの角は、金無双を相手にするときにも有効で、相振り飛車では頻出です。逆に相手からの筋違いの角打ちは、常に警戒して駒組みを進めましょう。
explain.en: White's only defense is to drop △9二角 from Diagram 1-2 (Diagram 1-4), but then ▲9五歩, attacking the edge and harassing the bishop, is enough. Simply being able to drop ▲5六角 gives an advantage, so it is a drop to always aim for in Opposing Ranging Rook games. This off-line bishop drop on 5六 is also effective against a Kinmusou (double gold) setup and is frequent in Opposing Ranging Rook. Conversely, always watch for the opponent's off-line bishop drop while developing.

section.ja: ▲5六角とする攻め
section.en: Attack with ▲5六角

title.ja: 図2-1 6六角型の場合
title.en: Figure 2-1: The 6六 bishop formation

explain.ja: 次は角交換していないときに使える棒銀の攻め筋です。角が6六にいることと、持ち歩が2枚あることがポイントです。向かい飛車でよく出てきそうな形です。
explain.en: Next is a Climbing Silver attack usable when the bishops have not been exchanged. The key points are that the bishop is on 6六 and that you have two pawns in hand. This shape often arises in Opposing Rook games.

section.ja: 6六角型の攻め
section.en: Attack with the 6六 bishop

title.ja: 図2-2 歩のたたきがポイント
title.en: Figure 2-2: The pawn tap is the key

explain.ja: ▲8四歩、△同歩までは自然な手ですが、次に▲8三歩と叩くのがポイントです。この歩がないと、次に▲8四銀と出た後に手がなくなります。これは叩きの歩の手筋です。
explain.en: ▲8四歩 △同歩 is natural, but then hitting with ▲8三歩 is the key. Without this pawn, you run out of moves after ▲8四銀. This is the striking-pawn (tataki no fu) tesuji.

section.ja: 6六角型の攻め
section.en: Attack with the 6六 bishop

title.ja: 図2-3 さらに歩を叩く
title.en: Figure 2-3: Tap with another pawn

explain.ja: 歩を叩いた効果で後手の銀が8三に上がってくるので、▲8四銀として銀交換を狙います。ただし後手の銀を▲同飛と取る前に、さらに▲8三歩と叩くのがポイントです。これは相手が△8三歩と打って合い駒するのを防ぎます。「敵の打ちたいところに打て」です。
explain.en: Because of the striking pawn, White's silver comes up to 8三, so ▲8四銀 aims at a silver exchange. But before capturing White's silver with ▲同飛, the key is to strike again with ▲8三歩. This prevents White from interposing with a △8三歩 drop. It follows the proverb "play where the enemy wants to drop."

section.ja: 6六角型の攻め
section.en: Attack with the 6六 bishop

title.ja: 図2-4 叩きの歩の効果で合駒できない
title.en: Figure 2-4: The tapped pawn prevents interposing

explain.ja: あらかじめ歩を捨てておいた効果で、飛車を走らせたときに合い駒ができません。ここから飛車と取った銀を使ってじわじわ駒得していけば優勢です。棒銀風の美濃崩しのポイントは、角交換している場合は▲5六角と打つこと、していないときは▲6六角と構えること、そして叩きの歩です。
explain.en: Because the pawn was sacrificed beforehand, no interposition is possible when the rook runs. From here, using the rook and the captured silver to win material gradually gives an advantage. The points of the Climbing Silver-style Mino break are: after a bishop exchange drop ▲5六角, without one set the bishop on 6六, and use the striking pawn. Next come edge attacks; the edge is said to be the Mino castle's biggest weakness, so know edge-attack tesuji well when playing Opposing Ranging Rook.

section.ja: 6六角型の攻め
section.en: Attack with the 6六 bishop

title.ja: 図3-1 端攻めの基本図
title.en: Figure 3-1: Basic diagram of the edge attack

explain.ja: まず端攻めの基本形です。端攻めが成立するかは、お互いの歩の枚数や端歩を突いているか、桂馬の位置など様々な要因で決まります。今回は端を突き越していて、角が6六に構えているときの端攻めを見ます。
explain.en: First, the basic form of the edge attack. Whether it works depends on various factors such as each side's pawns, whether the edge pawn has been pushed, and the knight's position. This time the edge pawn has been pushed past and the bishop is set on 6六.

section.ja: 端攻めは美濃囲いの最大の弱点!
section.en: Edge attack is the biggest weakness of Mino castle!

title.ja: 図3-2 9三に歩を打つのが端攻めの基本
title.en: Figure 3-2: Dropping a pawn on 9三 is the basic edge attack

explain.ja: 端歩を突き捨てて9三に歩を打つのが端攻めの基本です。後手が無視したら▲9四香と走ります。△同桂に対しても▲9四香と走るのが好手です。
explain.en: Pushing the edge pawn and sacrificing it, then dropping a pawn on 9三, is the basic edge attack. If White ignores it, run the lance with ▲9四香. Against △同桂 too, running ▲9四香 is a good move.

section.ja: 端攻めは美濃囲いの最大の弱点!
section.en: Edge attack is the biggest weakness of Mino castle!

title.ja: 図3-3 桂馬で香を狙う
title.en: Figure 3-3: Target the lance with the knight

explain.ja: 後手の香車を桂馬で狙います。香車は後ろへ下がれないので、一度前に出ると動けなくなります。
explain.en: Aim the knight at White's lance. A lance cannot retreat, so once it steps forward it gets stuck.

section.ja: 端攻めは美濃囲いの最大の弱点!
section.en: Edge attack is the biggest weakness of Mino castle!

title.ja: 図3-4 端が陥落
title.en: Figure 3-4: The edge falls

explain.ja: 香車を取って端が陥落します。ここから▲9二飛と回る手や、▲8四角などで端に駒を足していく手が厳しくなります。
explain.en: Capturing the lance makes the edge fall. From here, swinging the rook with ▲9二飛 or adding pieces to the edge with something like ▲8四角 is severe.

section.ja: 端攻めは美濃囲いの最大の弱点!
section.en: Edge attack is the biggest weakness of Mino castle!

title.ja: 図4-1 端攻めと棒銀の組み合わせ
title.en: Figure 4-1: Combining the edge attack with Climbing Silver

explain.ja: 次は棒銀と端攻めを組み合わせた崩し方です。これも頻出の手筋で、端攻めと棒銀のコンビネーションです。
explain.en: Next is a break combining Climbing Silver and the edge attack. It is another frequent tesuji, a combination of the two.

section.ja: 棒銀を組み合わせた端攻め
section.en: Edge attack combined with Rushing Silver

title.ja: 図4-2 まずは端歩から
title.en: Figure 4-2: Start with the edge pawn

explain.ja: まず端の歩から捨てるのがポイントです。この突き捨ての意味は、数手進めるとわかります。
explain.en: The key is to first sacrifice the edge pawn. The meaning of this pawn push becomes clear a few moves later.

section.ja: 棒銀を組み合わせた端攻め
section.en: Edge attack combined with Rushing Silver

title.ja: 図4-3 銀香交換に持ち込むのがポイント
title.en: Figure 4-3: The key is forcing a silver-for-lance exchange

explain.ja: ここから8筋に手をつけて棒銀らしく攻めます。△8三歩としっかり守られると攻め駒が足りないようですが、▲9五銀と下がって攻めが続きます。銀を9筋に下がれるよう、あらかじめ端を突き捨てていたのです。
explain.en: From here start on the 8th file and attack in Climbing Silver style. If White defends firmly with △8三歩 you seem to lack attackers, but retreating with ▲9五銀 keeps the attack going. The edge pawn was pushed in advance so that the silver could retreat to the 9th file.

section.ja: 棒銀を組み合わせた端攻め
section.en: Edge attack combined with Rushing Silver

title.ja: 図4-4 香車を足して端を攻める
title.en: Figure 4-4: Add a lance to attack the edge

explain.ja: 銀香交換で駒損になりますが、端を守る香車を剥がせたのが大きく、▲9九香と端を重点的に攻めれば先手が良くなります。ここからさらに▲6六角と出たり、飛車を9筋に回ったりして端に駒を足していけます。
explain.en: The silver-for-lance exchange loses material, but removing the lance guarding the edge is big, and concentrating on the edge with ▲9九香 favors Black. From here Black can add pieces to the edge, for example with ▲6六角 or by swinging the rook to the 9th file.

section.ja: 棒銀を組み合わせた端攻め
section.en: Edge attack combined with Rushing Silver

title.ja: 図5-1 香車をかすめ取る手順
title.en: Figure 5-1: Sequence to snatch the lance

explain.ja: 最後に、美濃囲いの香車をかすめ取る手筋を紹介します。すぐに囲いを崩せるわけではありませんが、駒得しながら美濃囲いを弱体化できるので、実戦で使ってみましょう。
explain.en: Finally, a tesuji that snatches the Mino castle's lance. It does not break the castle at once, but it weakens the Mino castle while winning material, so try it in real games.

section.ja: 香車をかすめ取る頻出手筋
section.en: Common tesuji to snatch the lance

title.ja: 図5-2 まずはいつもの手筋
title.en: Figure 5-2: First, the usual tesuji

explain.ja: まずはいつもの端攻めの手筋で、端歩を突き捨ててから▲9三歩と打ちます。
explain.en: First, use the usual edge-attack tesuji: push and sacrifice the edge pawn, then drop ▲9三歩.

section.ja: 香車をかすめ取る頻出手筋
section.en: Common tesuji to snatch the lance

title.ja: 図5-3 香得が確定
title.en: Figure 5-3: Winning the lance is certain

explain.ja: △9三香と来たら、さらに▲9四歩で香車を吊り上げ、その香車を銀で取りに行けば駒得です。すぐに美濃囲いが崩れるわけではありませんが、端を守る要の駒を剥がしながら駒得できました。ここからじっくり指せば先手が良くなります。△9三玉なら香車は守れますが、形があまりにも悪くなります。
explain.en: If White plays △9三香, ▲9四歩 lures the lance up, and capturing it with the silver wins material. The Mino castle does not collapse immediately, but Black wins material while removing the key piece guarding the edge. Playing patiently from here favors Black. △9三玉 would protect the lance but leaves a very bad shape.

section.ja: 香車をかすめ取る頻出手筋
section.en: Common tesuji to snatch the lance

title.ja: 図a-1 いきなり▲9四歩と打つ手は？
title.en: Figure a-1: What about a sudden ▲9四歩 drop?

explain.ja: 図5-1から▲9五歩、△同歩、▲9四歩と打つ手を考えた方もいるかもしれません。ここで後手が△同香としてくれれば、▲8五銀で香車が取れる上に歩を1枚節約できます。
explain.en: Some of you may have considered ▲9五歩, △同歩, ▲9四歩 from Diagram 5-1. If White takes with △同香 there, ▲8五銀 captures the lance and saves a pawn.

section.ja: 香車をかすめ取る頻出手筋
section.en: Common tesuji to snatch the lance

title.ja: 図a-2 端歩を無視される
title.en: Figure a-2: The edge pawn is ignored

explain.ja: しかし図a-1では、後手が9四の歩を無視してくることが考えられます。そうなると次に▲9五香と香車を走らせても、△9二歩で受けられます。
explain.en: However in Diagram a-1, White may ignore the pawn on 9四. Then even if you run the lance next with ▲9五香, White defends with △9二歩.

section.ja: 香車をかすめ取る頻出手筋
section.en: Common tesuji to snatch the lance
